name: General Mills - Great Falls MT (Flour Mill)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed at 2500 9th Ave N, Great Falls, MT 59401 - an active General Mills flour mill / grain elevator. Roster geocode moved 49m and resolved correctly onto the mill. Verified by web search (Montana Chamber grain-elevator listing, CMac grain-elevator directory) and a 'General Mills' sign visible on the building in Street View.
fieldNotes.facilityCharacter: This is a grain-milling / flour-mill operation, not a truck-yard distribution site. The complex runs E-W along a rail corridor: tall grain-elevator silos on the W, processing/mill buildings in the center, a long warehouse on the E. Freight is predominantly RAIL - covered hopper railcars sit on multiple sidings against the mill and warehouse in both satellite and Street View imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fencing is visible along the property frontage in Street View. Truck access is via gates in that fence off the gravel rail-side service road / 9th Ave N. No barrier arm crisply visible, so flagged uncertain - classified true on the fenced-perimeter-with-gated-access basis.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at or near the gates in satellite or Street View imagery. false -> remoteGs=true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck operations are secondary: a flour-truck loadout area near the silos and a modest dock canopy on the warehouse S face. Estimated 0-10 truck dock doors. Most loading is into railcars, not trucks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated trailer drop yard on-site - dropArea=NONE, dropYard=false. Only 1-2 trailers visible in the yard in the imagery captured.
fieldNotes.scale: Grain mills almost always weigh inbound/outbound trucks; a truck scale is highly likely near the truck loadout but could not be crisply isolated in overhead imagery - scale=true at low confidence, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: Strongly rail-served - covered hopper railcars on multiple sidings against the mill and warehouse; this is the primary freight mode for a flour mill.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the city of Great Falls, surrounded by residential blocks to the S and commercial/industrial development to the N - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Counted as 3: the grain-elevator/silo headhouse, the central mill/processing building, and the long E warehouse - one contiguous campus, multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined entry/exit via gravel service road; precise lane count not determinable - estimated 1/1.
